description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Stateless change detection on readable page text (same HTTP-first extraction as readfetch_text): fetch the URL, compare to a hash or prior body you store client-side, return changed/unchanged plus optional line diff. First call with no prior fields returns a baseline hash (see hint). `previous_hash` alone detects change without a line diff; add `previous_content` when you need added/removed/diff. A no-change answer is still billable when text was delivered. Prefer readfetch_text when you need the full article once; readfetch_probe (free) for a short preview and `content_sha256` before spending on text.

format.description: Extraction flavour for this fetch and for the hash (default text). Must match how you built `previous_content` if you send it.

previous_content.description: Full prior extracted text (what you stored from readfetch_text/readfetch_diff). Required for `added`/`removed`/`diff` output; hash-only compares do not emit a line diff.

previous_hash.description: `sha256:…` or bare hex from readfetch_diff, readfetch_probe `content_sha256`, or a prior text read. Omit on the first poll to establish a baseline hash in the response.

timeout_s.description: Total budget for the whole call in seconds, both fetches included. 60 s is the ceiling on this route.

url.description: Public http(s) page to re-fetch and compare; must match the extraction used when you saved the hash (same `format`).

name: readfetch_diff
